notes.title: February discount!
notes.content:
In this occasion, a new discount was launched leaving the game at 0.79 US cents.

It was our best option, we are planning a new project which will be available if all the plans do well on this December (2017).

Thank you for the support guys, you are the best.

notes.title: Fix 1
notes.content:
English:

. Improved the optimization of the game.
. Improved the lights.
- Increase the global-lightning of the game.
- Scene 5 key fixed.

Hope you enjoy the game!

Spanish:

- Mejorada la optimizacion del juego.
- Mejorada las luces del juego.
- Aumentada la luz global del juego.
- Llave de la escena 5 solucionado.

Espero que les guste!

notes.title: 100 sales. 100 ventas
notes.content:
Hi guys! We are doing great, people are loving the game, and all this results where for you. You are the best, seriously. 

Bueno, en Español me manejo mejor que en Ingles. Aprovecho para decir por este medio que agradezco infinitamente a las comunidades de Steam Mexico, Uruguay, Latinoamerica, a Dross, Town, Menos Trece, Artu, Breif, Bers y todos los chicos que estan siempre ayudandonos.
Enserio son LEJOS los mejores. Un orgullo que no haya fallos y que les guste.
